stem: Two cars start the race with velocities u<sub>1</sub> and u<sub>2</sub> and travel in straight line with acceleration ‘α’ and ‘β’. If both reach the finish line at the same time, then the range of the race is?

assets.alt: Velocity–time graph of two cars: car 1 starts at u₁ with acceleration α (gentle line), car 2 starts lower at u₂ with acceleration β (steeper line). The areas under both lines are equal up to time T.
